_about: Memory questions against history.json. expected = the conversation that should be recalled first, 'none' when there is no such chat (Neko must say so, not guess), or 'ask' when the question is ambiguous (Neko must ask which one). 'needs' says which signal can find it: 'date', 'keywords' or 'meaning' (words that never appear in the chat). split: 'dev' cases were used to tune thresholds; 'holdout' cases were written before any tuning and never used for it, so their score shows whether the tuning generalises.
